title: Return to Form
imageAlt: Return to Form collective release announcement
summary: More than twenty artists explore a shared theme in a group release on Rarible, paired with an exhibition at Lume Studios.
body: A collective release with room for different voices. Return to Form brought together more than twenty artists and extended the digital collection into a physical gallery event in New York.
The collection was announced live on November 12, 2025. Visit the marketplace for individual works and their current availability.

title: Art, in your hand
imageAlt: Artist-designed MTG proxy card featuring 3D artwork by emotionull
summary: Custom card packs featuring Burrito artists. Made for playing, sharing, and seeing familiar work in a new way.
body: Burrito artists made custom MTG proxy cards for the collective’s first draft at NFT NYC ’26. Art moved from the screen into people’s hands, with packs made for playing and sharing around the same table.

The event paired the draft with a group exhibition at Lume Studios and hands-on VR demos. The original pack preview features 3D artwork by emotionull; the event photos show the cards out in the world.
These are artist-made proxy cards. Contact the collective for information about the packs and availability.
